resources.string: Notes

Choose a dedicated phone-storage subfolder, for example NotesBackups in Downloads. Notes alternates between two encrypted backup files and verifies each save locally. New pairs save each attachment once, in an attachments folder beside the two files; routine saves don\'t re-read attachments saved earlier. Sync the whole folder, including subfolders, in upload-only mode. Local verification does not confirm an external upload.
This pair saves every attachment again in each backup file. Create a new backup pair to save each attachment only once. The current files are kept.

The backup\'s attachment files could not be checked, so their condition is unverified. No backup file was overwritten. Check access and retry with Back up now, or create a new pair if files are missing.
The backup\'s attachment folder could not be accessed, so its files could not be checked. No backup file was overwritten. Check backup access in Settings and retry when access is available.
An attachment file of this backup pair is missing or has changed size. No backup file was overwritten. Create a new pair and keep the old files for recovery.
An attachment no longer matches the copy saved in this backup pair, for example after restoring a different backup. Create a new pair; the old files are kept.
Choose the attachments folder

This backup keeps its attachments in a separate folder, %1$s, beside the backup file. Choose that folder or the folder that contains it, even if it was moved or renamed. Check that all of its files have finished syncing.
Choose folder
Use this backup provider?

This provider may delay reads, reject repeated writes, or lose access after reboot. A dedicated phone-storage subfolder with both files synced in upload-only mode is recommended. A save succeeds only after Notes can read back and verify it.
Your single-file backup is preserved and is no longer updated. Choose a folder to create a verified A/B pair.
Backup settings could not be confirmed. Close and restart Notes before changing backups. Existing files are retained.
A backup operation is already running or the session is unavailable. Wait and try again.
The latest backup failed. Check storage and the provider, then tap Back up now to retry. The active file was not overwritten by this attempt.
The active backup file could not be read, so its condition could not be verified. No backup file was overwritten. Check access and retry with Back up now, or create a new pair if the file is missing.

The active backup file could not be accessed, so its condition could not be verified. No backup file was overwritten. Check backup access in Settings and retry when access is available, or create a new pair if the file is missing or remains inaccessible.
Check backup access
The new backup pair could not be created and verified. Check storage and the provider, then choose a folder again. Existing backup files were not overwritten.
The selected folder could not be accessed. Choose the folder again and allow access, or choose another folder.
Setup: %1$s
The backup folder selection is no longer valid. Unlock Notes and select the folder again.
The folder picker could not be opened. Try choosing a backup folder again.
Changes could not be saved. Free some storage and correct or retry the note before reviewing backups.
%1$s (provider filename unavailable; requested name)
Review backup
Use anyway
Choose again
Backup access is unavailable. Restore the folder permission or choose the folder again to create a new pair.
Backup metadata exceeds the 16 MiB limit. Reduce note text or metadata before retrying. Attachment payloads have no total backup size limit.
The confirmed recovery phrase is unavailable. Backups are paused. Review your recovery phrase or restore using your saved words; Notes will not generate replacement words.
The restored recovery phrase differs from this pair. View and review the recovery phrase, then create a new backup pair. The old files remain encrypted with their original phrase.
The last verified backup has changed or is damaged. No file was overwritten. Create a new pair and keep the old files for recovery.
Backup configuration is invalid. Restart Notes before changing backups. Existing files are retained.
A backup still needs to finish. The previous verified slot remains active until a new save is verified and recorded.
Preparing and verifying encrypted backup…
